```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Commitment to hold the VA accountable for tangible results and steady improvement of its services.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The VA must become more responsive and more efficient by eliminating its disability backlog and reducing waiting times for treatment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to recruit the next generation of highly qualified medical professionals to ensure the VA provides veterans with world class medical care, both at its own facilities and through partnerships with community providers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Veterans should be provided access to qualified out-of-network providers where distance or crowding is an obstacle to traditional VA facility-based care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to greater attention by the VA to the special health care needs of women veterans, who will comprise an even larger percentage of VA patients in the future.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The VA's current disability compensation formulas need to be restructured and modernized.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Those who have borne the burden of war must have access to training, rehabilitation, and education.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Families and caregivers of veterans deserve concern and support.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to special attention to combat stress injuries.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Veterans and their families must have adequate counseling when veterans return home.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Veterans should have ongoing professional care, whether in a VA facility or closer to home, so that the natural and usually temporary responses to the horrors of war do not become permanent conditions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Recognition of the need for more mental health professionals who can give the highest quality treatment to veterans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
